additional_info.subject: OCPP communication lost and not restored after reboot - Serial No. 170000467
additional_info.body:
Hi Siemens Support,
OCPP communication was lost on 17/12 around 22:28.
Since then, the charger remains offline in the CSMS (Driivz), and the connector status changed to Unknown.
We performed both hard and soft reboots of the charger, but the OCPP communication did not recover.
Charger serial number: 170000467
Please advise on the root cause and the required steps to restore communication.
Best regards,
Ziv

We recommend coordinating the service arrangement with the regional operator, RC-IL, after which we will be able to continue supporting you as required.

additional_info.subject: ID0468321-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP/P4 170000467] OCPP communication lost CRM:02889000943
additional_info.body:
Dear Ziv,
Thank you for reaching out to us.
After reviewing the issue you reported and based on the information provided, we are pleased to confirm that at the moment the OCPP connection is operating normally, and no errors are currently shown in the system.
However, in order for us to perform a more detailed analysis, we kindly ask you to provide additional information about the issue you observed (e.g., the exact date and time when the OCPP connection appeared offline).
Best regards,
Ivan Perotto
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
